info.name: Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Platform
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Platform.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` variable to your server URL (default: http://localhost:5000)
2. Run 'SuperAdmin Login' first to get auth token
3. Create an Organization, then create an Org Admin
4. Run 'Admin Login' to get org-level token
5. Use the various modules to manage the store

## Variables
- `baseUrl`: Server base URL
- `superadminToken`: Auto-set after SuperAdmin login
- `adminToken`: Auto-set after Admin login
- `customerToken`: Auto-set after Customer login
- `orgSlug`: Organization slug for store routes
- `orgId`: Organization ID
